chapters.title: Why the perfect prompt is a myth
The myth of the perfect prompt

takeaways: Copilot works best with iterative, layered prompts built on goal, context, expectations and sources rather than one oversized request.
Relevant context such as company values, vocabulary and templates, plus deliberate tone, makes Copilot output match your organization instead of generic filler.
Newer models like GPT-5 amplify both good and bad prompting habits, so verification and systematic prompting matter more than ever.
hook: Many Microsoft 365 Copilot users chase a perfect one-shot prompt and get generic results. This episode shows experienced users how iteration, focused context and deliberate tone produce precise, business-ready output, and why newer models make that discipline more important.
